W1.evidence: generateSecret, generateKeyPair, importPKCS8, importSPKI, importJWK, and importX509 now yield a CryptoKey instead of a KeyObject in Node.js

W2.evidence: createRemoteJWKSet now uses fetch, because of that its Node.js only options.agent property has been removed and new fetch-related options were added

W3.evidence: The PEMImportOptions type interface is renamed to KeyImportOptions.

W4.evidence: resolved keys returned as part of verify/decrypt operations (when get key functions are used) are always normalized to either Uint8Array / CryptoKey depending on what's more efficient for the executed operation
